_readme: Corpus for score.screen._quote_states_refusal. Every sentence came from a real posting, a labeled row in the 2026-07-25 set, or a code review that produced it as a concrete counter-example -- none are invented to fit the implementation. Costs are asymmetric: a must_keep failure SILENTLY DISCARDS A REAL JOB; a must_flag failure wastes one paid fit call. Grow must_keep whenever a collision is found. Add a refusal pattern only with a must_flag sentence that needs it AND must_keep still passing. A must_flag the positive-evidence patterns do not cover is a KNOWN MISS, listed below, not a licence to widen a pattern until the fixture goes green.
